recipe.visualDefinition: A central, medium-shot portrait of a white Bull Terrier wearing a white button-down shirt and a black necktie. The dog is positioned against a background of horizontal venetian blinds illuminated with warm, orange-toned light. A small polaroid-style photo of a man is tucked into the shirt pocket. The overall mood is a blend of deadpan humor and 1980s pop-rock aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: The dog's white fur and shirt contrast against the dark black tie and shadows.
The horizontal lines of the blinds create a rhythmic texture that competes with the verticality of the tie.
The warm orange backlight creates a halo effect around the dog's silhouette.
coreInvariants: Bull Terrier breed with characteristic egg-shaped head
Human business attire (shirt and tie) on the animal

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dog's black nose and open mouth (pink tongue) serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the dog's face, moves down the vertical line of the tie, then to the pocket photo, and finally to the text blocks in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background texture fills all areas not occupied by the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm orange and brown tones from the background lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Stark white of the dog and shirt against deep black shadows and tie.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pink of the dog's tongue and skin tones in the pocket photo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the bright white shirt and the dark, saturated shadows of the blinds.

letterConstructionRules: Placed inside dark rectangular blocks (label-maker style)

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in negative space of background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying block sizes for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Dark rectangular background strips behind text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric monolinear look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a white Bull Terrier wearing a white dress shirt and black tie, sitting in front of horizontal venetian blinds with warm orange backlighting. Include a small photo tucked into the shirt pocket.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three to four lines of white geometric sans-serif text in the upper right. Each line should be contained within its own black rectangular block with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the dog a Bull Terrier?
Are the blinds horizontal and glowing orange?
Is the text in black blocks with wide tracking?
Is there a photo in the shirt pocket?

adjustableVariables: Dog breed (though Bull Terrier is iconic)
mustRedesign: Specific face of the man in the pocket photo
Exact wording of the original artist name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the dog's head shape is anatomically correct for the breed.
Check that the blinds do not look like digital noise.
Verify the text blocks are aligned to the right.
Confirm the shirt collar fits the dog's neck realistically.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject: [Animal] in [Human Clothing] + Background: [Linear Texture] with [Warm Backlight] + Typography: [Geometric Sans in Black Blocks]
